node.title: Re: Braces around a section of code
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
As the others have already said, the blocks introduce a new scope, and there are quite a few things in Perl that are lexically scoped. Just to add some more to the list that haven't been mentioned yet: several pragmas, such as [doc://strict] and [doc://warnings], are also lexically scoped, and there are a few (rare!) cases where one might want to temporarily disable parts of those pragmas for a very small block of code.

By the way, I would recommend properly indenting the inner blocks as well. [mod://perltidy] can help.
